description: Report the EIP-7702 delegation status of your Q402 wallet (the EOA derived from Q402_PRIVATE_KEY) across all 12 Q402-supported chains. Returns per-chain { delegated, impl } and a one-line summary. Read-only - no signing, no on-chain TX, no quota consumption. Pair with q402_clear_delegation when the user wants to reset a specific chain. Requires Q402_PRIVATE_KEY in env (same as q402_pay).
name: q402_wallet_status
